agent.problem: The card retells the gentle-lamb image from Jeremiah 11:19, but its citation is only Jeremiah 12:3-4 and it gives no reference for 11:19. The citation therefore does not cover everything the card tells.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: The question depends on "the picture of the race" from card 10, but that story card is no longer on screen and the question does not restate the race. The question itself needs the comparison between racing men on foot and competing with horses.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives the baker a basis for choosing brothers rather than servants or soldiers. The blank therefore tests wording the baker has not seen instead of a meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
